messages:
Priya: FYI the nightly doc-link scan popped a cluster of 404s in docs/runtime/runtime-guide.md under the 'KV cache tuning' block. One external gist gone, a pair of s3-hosted images, and an anchor that no longer matches. Anyone available to take a quick patch?
DocsBot: nightly-scan: detected 1 dead gist, 2 broken image URLs, 1 orphan anchor in /docs/runtime/runtime-guide.md (approx lines 438-498). Report: https://internal.docs/reports/1787654322-scan :mag:
Marco: I'm on call this afternoon but can take a tiny non-blocking PR. Prefer we inline any tiny snippets and rehost images to CDN to avoid future rot.
Tiffany: I can rehost the images to our CDN (https://cdn.redwood.ai/assets/) and normalize alt text. If we inline the gist, make sure we keep the code fence language hint for syntax highlighting.
Jamal: Quick check: is the orphan anchor referenced from TOC? If so we should either restore the anchor or update the link. I can grep the repo.
Priya: Thanks all. Anchor appears to be a renamed header: `### KV cache heuristics` -> `### KV cache tuning`. I'm planning to restore the old anchor as a small html anchor tag so older links keep working.
Tiffany: Proposed local steps:
```bash
# find occurrences
rg "gist.github.com/deleted-kv|s3://redwood-assets/kv-" docs/runtime/runtime-guide.md -n
# replace s3 -> cdn host
sed -i "s|s3://redwood-assets/|https://cdn.redwood.ai/assets/|g" docs/runtime/runtime-guide.md
```
Tiffany: I'll also upload kv-diagram.png and kv-cache-example.png to the CDN and update the markdown with proper alt text.
Marco: I'll inline the gist (small snippet ~30 lines) and add a short note in the changelog: "inline: KV cache example (gist removed upstream)". I'll nominate @pri for review.
Priya: Sounds good. Please add the scan report link in the PR description and tag `docs, quick-fix`. Also include the reason for reintroducing an HTML anchor for backwards compatibility.
Jamal: Opened a quick issue to track cross-references in case other pages point to that anchor: https://github.com/redwood/docs/issues/9876
Tiffany: PR coming shortly. I'll request reviews from @marco and @pri, plus a copy check from @jamal for the anchor note.
DocsBot: CI: running docs build + link-check on PR. Will post results here once done.
Marco: Quick heads-up: when inlining, wrap the snippet in a short explanatory comment so readers know it was from the now-deleted gist and was inlined for stability.
Priya: Agreed. Also add `i18n: no` if this is EN-only to avoid unnecessary backport work.
Tiffany: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/13501 - description includes scan link, files changed, and i18n note. Tagging reviewers.
Marco: Reviewing now. Left one nit about code fence language and one about an alt text phrasing.
Jamal: Confirmed that TOC references now land correctly with restored anchor. No other pages referencing the old anchor.
DocsBot: Re-scan queued after merge. Will update thread when the run completes.
Priya: Thanks team 44D I'll resolve once CI + re-scan green.
